spanish: Siete días expiarás sobre el altar, y lo santificarás, y será el altar santo de santos; todo el tocante en el altar será santo.
grammarChanges: h02029037015 (יִקְדָּשׁ, qal imperfect 3ms, stative): replaced 'se santificará' (reflexive/passive of the piel factitive) with 'será santo' to keep the qal stative force 'shall be holy', matching the freeze rule that stem force (e.g. vivirá, not que viva) is not to be converted into a derived-stem sense.
